title: Rate Sheet Addendum: Payment Standing and the Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Interest Rate
content:
**Addendum.** On a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion, the plan's autopay discount gives way to the account's payment standing: an account enrolled in autopay with no payment returned in the twelve months before the posting and at least the loyalty count of 24 whole scheduled payments covered takes the loyalty discount of 0.50% off the purchase APR instead; an account not enrolled in autopay with at least the returned count of 2 payments returned in those twelve months adds the returned-payment premium of 1.00% to the purchase APR; any other account takes the plan's autopay discount off while enrolled and nothing otherwise.

**Whole scheduled payments covered** are scheduled-payment entries net of returned payments, divided by the scheduled monthly payment of the plan's payment factor per 1,000.00 times the financed amount, rounded to the cent and at least the plan's minimum monthly payment, and rounded down to a whole number. The twelve months are counted back from the day the interest is posted.

## Standing table

| Autopay on the posting day | Payments returned in the 12 months | Whole scheduled payments covered | Effect on the purchase APR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enrolled | None | 24 or more | Less 0.50% (in place of the plan's autopay discount) |
| Enrolled | None | 23 or fewer | Less the plan's autopay discount |
| Enrolled | 1 or more | Any | Less the plan's autopay discount |
| Not enrolled | 2 or more | Any | Plus 1.00% |
| Not enrolled | 0 or 1 | Any | No change |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

- Enrolled, no returns, 24 covered: less 0.50%; 23 covered: less the plan's autopay discount.
- Not enrolled, 2 returns in the 12 months: plus 1.00%; 1 return: no change.
